brooks.title: Stephen King: A Primary Bibliography of the World's Most Popular Author
brooks.author: Justin Brooks
brooks.accessScope: Publisher and library metadata/description consulted. No complete authorized text or primary-entry-by-entry comparison was available during this batch. Search also exposed a third-party 2013 revised-text mirror, whose completeness and provenance were not established; it was not used as a verified master list.
brooks.limit: The publisher describes coverage through 2005 across broader genres and publication appearances. Its entry counts cannot be equated with the current site's unique-fiction-work counts. Deep first-publication and rare-work checking remains open.

independentScreenComparison.access: Public web page consulted; direct scripted request returned 403 and was not bypassed.
independentScreenComparison.use: Discovery of additional derivative/remake/short-film groups; not used to assert unsupported current production status. See the supplementary screen queue.
